notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Lotus Petal.
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Chakram Retriever and Sai, Master Thopterist both trigger.
Resolve the Chakram Retriever trigger, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Sai, Master Thopterist trigger, creating a 1/1 Thopter token.
Lotus Petal resolves.
Repeat any number of times.
Activate Sai by paying {1}{U} and sacrificing two Thopter tokens to draw a card.
Repeat the previous step any number of times.
